GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Intensive reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Intensive reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Intensive reading.

2. When practising Reading for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading for comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading for comprehension.

3. When practising Intensive Reading Skimming, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Intensive Reading Skimming.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive Reading Skimming.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Intensive Reading Skimming.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive Reading Skimming.

4. When practising Public speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Public speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Public speaking.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Public speaking.

5. When practising Listening for details Conversational skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for details Conversational skills.

   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for details Conversational skills.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for details Conversational skills.

6. When practising Reading comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading comprehension.

7. When practising Extensive reading Scanning, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Extensive reading Scanning.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive reading Scanning.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Extensive reading Scanning.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Extensive reading Scanning.

8. When practising Listening comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening comprehension.

9. When practising Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.

10. When practising Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.

11. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Wasser
   B. Haus
   C. Schule
   D. Buch

12. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Good day / hello
   B. Thank you
   C. Good night
   D. Please

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Comprehension Extensive reading ● World currencies, ● Banking services ● and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Descriptive Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Expository writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Persuasive writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Creative writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Descriptive writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Functional writing At the Bank ● World currencies, ● Banking services ● Exchange and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Descriptors Adjectives , Comparative, Superlative -Vorlieben Ordinal numbers Dem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
